description: This Scala source file defines a tool for generating class and member exclusions for MIMA binary compatibility checks, focusing on package-private classes within the org.apache.spark package.

classes.name: GenerateMIMAIgnore
classes.description: Object containing methods to identify and generate exclusions for package-private classes and members in the org.apache.spark package.

methods.name: isPackagePrivate
methods.description: Checks if a Scala symbol is package-private based on its privateWithin fullName.

methods.name: isPackagePrivateModule
methods.description: Checks if a module symbol is package-private, with error handling.

methods.name: privateWithin
methods.description: Identifies classes and members within a package that are package-private or effectively private.

methods.name: getInnerFunctions
methods.description: Uses Java reflection to find inner functions with '$$' in their names within a class.

methods.name: getAnnotatedOrPackagePrivateMembers
methods.description: Filters class members to find package-private or annotated members, including inner functions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method that generates and writes class and member exclusion lists to files.

methods.name: shouldExclude
methods.description: Heuristic filter to exclude certain JVM classes from processing.

methods.name: getClasses
methods.description: Scans classpath for classes in a package and subpackages, filtering out excluded classes.
